html:
Every human has a Kasama, a dream-avatar that reflects their soul.

In Kasama: The Awakening, you’ll step into the dreamworld as Orion, a spirit warrior on a quiet quest through the fading realm of Kastania.

Uncover hidden truths, face your fears, and help restore balance to a world teetering between light and shadow.

This is a short, heartfelt journey, perfect for players who love story-rich games like Journey, Inside, or Oxenfree.

Will you dare to dream... and face the night with them?

Long ago, a sacred chestnut tree gave life to three mythical beings, protectors of the dreamworld and guides of the human soul:

• Ipno – the firstborn, guardian of restful sleep for all living things.
• Morpheo – the middle child, who grants the power to dream and glimpse other realities.
• Phao – the youngest, who wakes beings from dreams and helps them carry meaning into the real world.

But when the chestnuts that sustain this balance begin to vanish, the Kasamas grow weaker... and darkness creeps in.

Walk through floating forests, forgotten ruins, and shimmering dreamscapes as you piece together Kastania’s lost history.

Every place you visit reflects a feeling, a memory, or a fear, both personal and ancient.

Not all dreams are peaceful.
Some hold sorrow. Some conceal truths. Some fight back.
But only by facing them can you restore what was lost.



Kasama: The Awakening is the first chapter in a cinematic, episodic saga, built for one-night play sessions that leave a lasting impression.
